b1.erin_beats_the_hive_mind.news: People say the Human innkeeper beat a hundred Antinium at chess on her hill, and that the Drake tactician watching wept.

canon_ref.note: Evening of day 21, straight after 1.30. Selys says she saw a Soldier 'this morning', which fits loosely. Deltas are design values.

b1.erin_beats_the_hive_mind.summary: On the bloody hill, Pawn and a hundred Workers think as one and beat Erin again and again. Krshia and Selys explain levels; Pisces says she gets no [Tactician] levels because chess is only a game to her. She shows them the Immortal Game, then wins one last game in tears.

system.name: [Innkeeper]
system.note: In her sleep that night. She says she was level 10 before.

system.name: [Immortal Moment]
system.note: What it does is not shown; Pisces has never heard of it (1.34).
